|strategy=By Paul Evans<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/graxolkelvyyn.html</ref>

The current meta of podracing is divided into the racers and the non-racers. This mentality will change with the introduction of [[Graxol Kelvyyn]]. Although he is puny in stature when compared to the rest of the set, Graxol should have an impact, at least when it comes to podracing. With the ability to retrieve Force when ahead, Graxol should change the current meta into at least attempting to race which will intrigue the use of [[Losing Track]] to damage your opponent's podracer. Now, your opponent will be forced to decided to lose a Force to stack a card in hopes that he will be ahead or allow you free reign to retrieve a card. Either way, the Light Side comes out the winner. With Graxol, the opponent is placed in a lose-lose situation to either stack cards that may desperately be needed or by allowing you to retrieve at will until you see it fit to win the race and cause the 12 Force swing and the [[I Did It!]] damage.
|rulings=* A Podracer is 'leading the Podrace' if they have the highest race total (including a tie).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Graxol%20Kelvyyn</ref>
